title: Termix Plugin System + Redeisgn
message: If you have been active in the Discord recently, you will see that Termix will be shifting to a official and community plugin based system soon for many good reasons. Using the open demo button below, you can try out a demo version of the new plugin system UI redesign before it is released. To give feedback on this new UI, consider joining the Termix Discord or reporting it here: https://github.com/Termix-SSH/Demo/discussions
